title: Burning Lies
lead: Who are you? A poetic, multilingual short film about the fictions we tell ourselves in order to survive, belong and move through the world, and the process of letting them burn away.
text: Official selections on three continents in 2026. Through an Afrodiasporic lens, Burning Lies traces an intimate journey of self-discovery, confronting inherited expectations, projections and limiting beliefs.

Guided by poems written and performed by Dorcas Nsiama, the film moves between the Baltic coast near Rostock, dreamlike interiors and a digitally imagined Congolese rainforest. English, German, Lingala and Kikongo interweave as the protagonist moves toward a symbolic rebirth beyond illusion and ego.
The visual concept collected the three worlds of the film: the Baltic coast near Rostock, dreamlike interiors and a digitally imagined Congolese rainforest.
The notebook gathers textures, gestures and light for each of them, and the images that connect the poems by Dorcas Nsiama to the screen.

awards: Winner · Best Makeup & Styling, FAME Shorts 2026
